يستقطر (form X)

# يُسْتَقْطَرُ (yustaqṭaru) /jus.taq.tˤa.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَقْطَرَ (istaqṭara)
# يَسْتَقْطِرَ (yastaqṭira) /jas.taq.tˤi.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَقْ
